specialist_outputs.summary: Searched GE Appliances official product pages, GE 2022 Buying Guide PDF, GE support articles, GE parts pages, and multiple retailer spec sheets for all 17 slugs. Found 0 GSWF matches. 8 models use RPWFE, 7 use MWF/XWFE, 1 uses XWFE exclusively, 1 has no water dispenser at all. GSWF is confirmed as a discontinued cylindrical filter for older GTS/GTH/PTS/PDS top-freezer and bottom-freezer models only.

TOTAL FAMILY CONTAMINATION. 100% wrong-part rate — 0 of 17 slugs use GSWF. The GSWF family mapping contains exclusively models from other filter families (RPWFE, MWF/XWFE) and one no-filter model. GSWF is architecturally incompatible with all 17 models — different physical filter housing design. Family reconciliation severity should be CRITICAL. The GSWF filter itself may be discontinued (listed as clearance on geappliances.com).
